targets.description: Targets of the project, each declared output of every configuration is removed

commands.description: The tool's own clean commands, each an argument list

cwd.description: Folder the commands run in, relative to the workspace root

folders.description: Folders whose entries are removed, keeping the entry holding Nx's workspace data, each an environment variable naming a folder followed by path segments under it

patterns.description: Glob patterns relative to the workspace root, each match is removed whole unless the workspace tracks it or a file under it

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Clean
description: Runs the tool's own clean commands when given, then removes the outputs the named targets of the project declare and the matches of the named patterns, keeping any the workspace tracks as source, and empties the named folders
